serverMetadata.instructions:
The GitHub MCP Server provides tools to interact with GitHub platform.

Tool selection guidance:
	1. Use 'list_*' tools for broad, simple retrieval and pagination of all items of a type (e.g., all issues, all PRs, all branches) with basic filtering.
	2. Use 'search_*' tools for targeted queries with specific criteria, keywords, or complex filters (e.g., issues with certain text, PRs by author, code containing functions).

Context management:
	1. Use pagination whenever possible with batches of 5-10 items.
	2. Use minimal_output parameter set to true if the full information is not needed to accomplish a task.

Tool usage guidance:
	1. For 'search_*' tools: Use separate 'sort' and 'order' parameters if available for sorting results - do not include 'sort:' syntax in query strings. Query strings should contain only search criteria (e.g., 'org:google language:python'), not sorting instructions.

[project]
name = "devexhq-dovo"
dynamic = ["version"]
authors = [
    { name = "DevEx HQ Team", email = "team@devexhq.com" }
]
description = "Isolated Git worktrees for developer and AI agent automated workflow management.."
readme = "README.md"
requires-python = ">=3.13"
classifiers = [
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.13",
    "License :: OSI Approved :: MIT License",
    "Operating System :: OS Independent",
    "Environment :: Console",
    "Topic :: Software Development :: Version Control :: Git",
]
dependencies = [
    "typer>=0.9.0",
    "jsonschema>=4.0.0",
    "pyyaml>=6.0.0",
    "pydantic>=2.0.0",
    "sqlmodel>=0.0.22",
    "alembic>=1.13.0",
    "pre-commit>=4.6.2",
]

[project.urls]
Homepage = "https://devexhq.github.io/dovo/"
Repository = "https://github.com/devexhq/dovo"
"Bug Tracker" = "https://github.com/devexhq/dovo/issues"

[project.optional-dependencies]
dev = [
    "freezegun>=1.5.5",
    "pytest>=8.0.0",
    "pytest-cov>=4.0.0",
    "pytest-xdist>=3.5.0",
    "pytest-env>=1.1.0",
    "ruff>=0.6.0",
    "invoke>=2.0.0",
    "complexipy>=6.2.0",
    "basedpyright>=1.39.10",
]
docs = [
    "mkdocs>=1.5.0",
    "mkdocs-material>=9.5.0",
]

[project.scripts]
dovo = "dovo.cli.cli:app"

[build-system]
requires = ["hatchling", "hatch-vcs"]
build-backend = "hatchling.build"

# Installable import package lives at src/dovo (src-layout).
[tool.hatch.build.targets.wheel]
packages = ["src/dovo"]
# Editable: add src/ to sys.path via .pth only (avoid copying into site-packages).
dev-mode-dirs = ["src"]

[tool.hatch.build.targets.wheel.sources]
"src" = ""

# Hatchling replacement for your dynamic GitHub Actions version script
[tool.hatch.version]
source = "vcs"

[tool.hatch.version.raw-options]
# Ensures git tags like v1.0.0b1 map perfectly to PyPI version standards
local_scheme = "no-local-version"

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
addopts = "-q --strict-markers --strict-config -n auto"
testpaths = ["tests"]
# Repo root must be importable so `tests.*` helpers resolve when invoked via the
# `pytest` console script (sys.path[0] is not cwd in that mode).
pythonpath = ["."]
python_classes = ["Test*", "*Tests"]
